lines.say: POV: it's dark at half four and you missed Tuesday.
Now Wednesday has two days in it.
Usually, that's when the whole plan goes.
Tuesday happened. The plan just stepped round it.
Offload plans from your notes and exam dates.
When a day goes wrong, it moves the plan.
It tests you, and brings topics back before you forget.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
